entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Not only have we dealt with our second[n]big target, we even have a new addition[n]to the team!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Goodness, things are going so well!
We're on a roll.
We can't get too cocky.
It's all thanks to you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hehe... Could the day our name becomes[n]common knowledge be nigh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's true. Still, let's honestly be happy[n]about it right now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ahhh! If only I could make a certain,[n]stupid Ryuji learn from you...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I have to say, you sure are[n]something special.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is our fifth Persona-user. It'll help[n]broaden our battle strategies as well.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Besides, having an eye for beauty is[n]a must for phantom thieves. We're[n]lucky to have Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: An artist is a talent you rarely come[n]across. I mean, he IS a bit strange,[n]but still...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: An artist, huh...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What kind of person do you think I was?[n]There's no way I'd turn out to be some[n]bad guy in the end, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I get so engrossed with the embodiment[n]of human desires...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And that's not all. When it comes to[n]the Metaverse, I'm the only one who[n]can transform into a car...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm special... but it's still odd.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Who could I actually be?
A human.
A monster.
A cat.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You really think so?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm not some monster cat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Will you give it a rest!? That's definitely[n]not the case!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: *sigh* What a half-assed answer.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, there's no way a dashing,[n]honorable rogue like me could be evil.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A man who saves those in trouble in[n]the west, while punishing evildoers[n]who may lurk in the east!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A man who chastises people that smoke[n]inside in the south, while saving bullied[n]cats in the north.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A man who has a sturdy body and vows[n]to always do one good deed a day, be it[n]rain or shine.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm that kind of ideal person...[n]Or so I hope.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So if I turn back to being human...[n]surely she'll take notice of me,[n]won't she?
Probably...
We'll know eventually.
You like someone?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: R-Right! Of course that's the case!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, that's true, but...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Me!? Don't be ridiculous! People chase[n]after me when it comes to love!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Where should I go when I become[n]human? I wonder where she'd like[n]to go...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: An amusement park, a movie theater,[n]a fancy café, shopping...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you think?
I feel like my bond with[n]Morgana is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Я відчуваю, що мій зв'язок[n]із Морганою глибшає...
